summary: Temporary danger area EGD789 for drone flights beyond visual line of sight in the central North Sea, 72 nautical mile radius, surface to 1,300 feet above mean sea level.
text:
AIP SUP 080/2026 TEMPORARY DANGER AREA EGD789 (CENTRAL NORTH SEA -
NORTH) BVLOS OPERATIONS - EXTENDED UNTIL 24 NOVEMBER 2026.
